profile.headline: Junior AI Engineer | Machine Learning Engineer
profile.summary: Junior AI Engineer with hands-on experience building Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and AI-powered applications using Python. Experienced with NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, LLM APIs, AI Agents, FastAPI, Supabase, and Vercel. Built ML models, neural networks from scratch, AI lead-discovery systems, and end-to-end software applications. Currently advancing in PyTorch and AI Engineering through professional certifications and practical projects. Seeking a remote Junior AI Engineer / Machine Learning Engineer opportunity..

bullets: Developed practical software and AI applications combining machine learning, AI APIs, backend development, databases, and deployment.
Connecting frontend applications with backend and AI services.
Developing IntentFlow, an AI-powered lead discovery concept.

projects.subtitle: AI Lead Discovery System Freelance / AI Engineering Project
bullets: Built an AI agent concept that analyzes Reddit posts to identify potential buying intent and users requesting help. Designed an automated workflow for post analysis, intent detection, lead identification, and AI-generated reply suggestions.
Designed for integration with the Reddit API for automated data collection.
